notes.title: Patch Notes 1.10
notes.content:
We have released patch 1.10 for RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army. Additionally, accompanying this update, we would like to share a message from the game's Producer/Director, Yamai Kazuyuki.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558630/fc5bee167906c384a15da7ea4743ff0b43d1f218.png"]

Please see the details of the fixes included:

 

1) QOL Improvements

MAG can now be collected through gun attacks.

Added a “Hold” input option for Weak Sword Attacks and Strong Sword Attacks.

Button/key assigned to safeguarding demon allies is now remappable.

Demon allies will no longer waste MAG by using skills unnecessarily once battle ends.

Added “Retry battle on another difficulty” option when Raidou is defeated.

You can now sell demonic materials at Konnou-ya.

You can now travel directly to Konnou-ya through Dragon Founts.

Added ON/OFF toggles for the next objective UI, destination icons, and applicable investigation skills so players can enjoy the atmosphere of the original game.

Enhanced carry-over elements for New Game+.

Totality

Raidou's level, stats, money, Devil Chart, and accumulated Loyalty will be carried over. Summoner Skills, swords forged through Sword Alchemy, and items will also be carried over, with some exceptions.

Luxuries

Raidou's money, Devil Chart, and accumulated Loyalty will be carried over. Summoner Skills, swords forged through Sword Alchemy, and items will also be carried over, with some exceptions.

Basics

Raidou's Devil Chart and accumulated Loyalty will be carried over.

Balance adjustments for the following battles:

Episode 1: Gashadokuro

Episode 1: Ichimokuren

Episode 8: Mishaguji

Final Episode battles

Devil Chart now displays demon registration completion rate.

Added ON/OFF toggle for shortening demon fusion animations.

After demon fusion, the game will no longer return to the fusion top menu.

Shortened animation when reforging a sword that has already been crafted in Sword Alchemy.

Reduced downtime after summoning a demon ally in the field.

Added ability to skip the greeting animation during demon reports.

Even when Raidou’s title is manually selected, the rank-up animation will play when a new title is unlocked.

When completing a case file, the name of the completed quest will now be shown in the completion animation (to avoid confusion about which quest was cleared).

Reduced the frequency of Gouto saying “Use your gun.”

 

2) Other

Various bug fixes.

 

Thank you for your continued support of RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army!

We’re less than a month away from the release of RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army! Let’s check in with the latest game news, including some press preview articles for your reading, the first two episodes of our newest features series, and how you can score some free DLC items! 

Press Previews 
Hot off the press! Check out the positive things that have been mentioned about RAIDOU Remastered after our recent press previews. 

 “But make no mistake, RAIDOU Remastered, like its 2006 progenitor, is brimming with the unmistakable charm, panache, and creativity that Atlus has become so well-known for.” – Game Rant, RAIDOU Remastered: Mystery of the Soulless Army Is Atlus RPG Charm at Its Finest 
 “Raidou Remastered seems like it will be a promising remaster from Atlus, as well as an opportunity to introduce a larger audience to an interesting Shin Megami Tensei game.” – Siliconera, Preview: Raidou Remastered Offers a More Active SMT Experience 
 “And after playing through the first two chapters, I realized there’s much more going on here than I thought there would be.” – Noisy Pixel, Raidou Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army Preview – This Burdened Blade 
 “But what I’m really happy about is that the visual upgrade still holds some of the grunginess of the original PS2 game.” – Inverse, Raidou Remastered Is a Stunning Upgrade of a Seminal PS2 Game 
 “I spent three hours playing the remaster's first two chapters, and it's shaping up to be one of Atlus' best games, especially from a combat angle.” – Anime News Network, Raidou Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army Is Shaping Up to Be One of Atlus' Best Games

notes.title: PC System Requirements Revealed!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Please see below for the official PC system requirements of RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army: 

Minimum Requirements (Low settings 720p @ 60 FPS) 

Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system 
OS: Windows 10 
Processor: Intel Core i5-2550K or AMD FX-4350 
Memory: 6 GB RAM 
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 450 (1GB) or AMD Radeon R7 250 (1GB) 
DirectX: Version 11 
Storage: 20 GB available space
 
Recommended Requirements (High settings 1080p @ 60 FPS) 

 Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system 
 OS: Windows 10 
 Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 or AMD Ryzen 3 2300X 
 Memory: 8 GB RAM 
 Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 (4GB), AMD Radeon RX 560 (4GB), or Intel Arc A310 (4GB) 
 DirectX: Version 11 
 Storage: 20 GB available space 

Thanks for your support, and stay tuned for more news as we get closer to the June 18th launch!

notes.title: Announcing RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army!
notes.content:
Hello Raidou fans, 

We're pleased to announce RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army! Unleash the supernatural in a thrilling detective adventure set in a fantastical era of 1930s Tokyo. Play the action JRPG remaster in a brand-new way with revamped visuals, QOL changes, an overhauled battle system, and much more! 

Check out the announcement trailer: 

[previewyoutube=wrbHRMm0txM;full][/previewyoutube]
The Return of Raidou Kuzunoha | World Spotlight 

Want to dive deeper into the world of Raidou? Watch "The Return of Raidou Kuzunoha | World Spotlight", a special spotlight video now live on our YouTube channel. This 22-minute showcase details the game's setting, enhancements from the original version, as well as an interview with Director Kazuyuki Yamai. 

[previewyoutube=lIr3mDfEAlo;full][/previewyoutube]
Submit A Player Title To Add In-Game! 

We are giving all of you an opportunity to contribute a title to potentially be added into the game! Head over to our social media channels to participate, where you can submit a title suggestion using the hashtag #RaidouTitle. 

What kind of Devil Summoner are you? We look forward to your submissions! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558630/57470853db8d685a8aac7c36a9fcc2e44c5584d7.png 
Pre-Order Now 

RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army releases on June 19! Pre-order the game to receive the "Raidou Glasses" cosmetic item.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558630/9871db7d727f1659a7f8f158779efe53d40d3797.jpg
 
Enhance your experience with the Digital Deluxe Edition, which includes the following content: 

 RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army base game 
 Guest Demons Pack 
 Demons of the Aril Rift 
 Kuzunoha Village Trainings 
 Skill Book Pack 
 Survival Pack 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558630/c9c68d77d9b25b05c5bf1aa95921a4c327b8314d.jpg
A physical Collector's Edition from Limited Run Games is also en-route, please look forward to more details further down the line. 

We will share more about RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army in the coming weeks. For veterans and newcomers alike: Raidou is back!
